_doc: Single catalog of skills this standard installs for BOTH Claude Code and Codex. Edit with scripts/add-skill, not by hand. 'local' = skills/<name>; 'vendor' = git submodule pinned by commit. Optional per-skill 'notes' record known issues; they are shown in Agent Hub and referenced by global/AGENTS.md.

skills.name: modern-cpp
skills.notes: Targets C++20/23/26. Always use the project's pinned standard and toolchain (embedded is often C++11/14/17); only apply idioms that standard supports.

skills.name: embedded-systems
skills.notes: Known issue (Codex review 2026-11-24): the UART ISR sample keeps a single-byte buffer (bytes are lost under load) and re-enables IRQs unconditionally with __enable_irq(). Use a ring buffer/queue and save/restore PRIMASK (or the RTOS critical-section API) instead.
